question: Should OpenClaw accept purpose-specific memory role slots as core config/plugin API, using https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the canonical implementation path?
rationale: Current main still has one exclusive memory slot, while the proposed fix adds durable public config/API and migration behavior that automation should not decide without maintainer intent.

options.title: Review the role-slot PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the canonical candidate and decide taxonomy, compatibility, and proof there before closing this issue.

options.title: Narrow the taxonomy first
options.body: Keep this issue open as design work and ask the PR to reduce, rename, or stage the role slots before any public config surface lands.

options.title: Reject core role slots
options.body: Close this issue only if maintainers decide memory composition should stay outside core or use a different plugin API shape.

recommendation.title: Review the role-slot PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the canonical candidate and decide taxonomy, compatibility, and proof there before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a durable public config/plugin API direction choice, and steipete is listed as the project decision owner while also having relevant memory-slot history.
